Governor Wes Moore (@GovWesMoore)

Allegany and Garrett counties were hit hard by flooding – knocking out resources like power, water, and broadband.

In partnership with Maryland Broadband Cooperative Incorporated, we’re adding approximately 26 miles of fiber optic cable to underserved communities in Allegany and Garrett to help Marylanders get back on their feet.

Allegany and Garrett counties were hit hard by flooding – knocking out resources like power, water, and broadband.

In partnership with Maryland Broadband Cooperative Incorporated, we’re adding approximately 26 miles of fiber optic cable to underserved communities in Allegany and Garrett to help Marylanders get back on their feet.

The First Lady and I wish a Chag Pesach Sameach to the Jewish community here in Maryland.

The history of Passover – rooted in values of faith, freedom, and resilience – reminds us to continue our fight in overcoming darkness. May this season bring you strength, reflection, and a renewed sense of purpose.

DHS’s warehouse purchasing pause and review of past purchases is encouraging news. 

The federal government spent hundreds of millions in taxpayer money buying a warehouse near Hagerstown — without an environmental review and without public input. At the same time, they’ve slashed health care, cut food assistance, and denied aid for historic flooding in Western Maryland.

My top priority is keeping Marylanders safe. We will always work with the federal government to remove violent criminals, but

The current administration is doing irreparable harm, and they have to be held accountable and put in check.

Video

Maryland governors don’t normally attend Baltimore’s State of the City Address.

But the partnership I have with this city and this mayor is different. And it’s because we’ve decided to move together to achieve results for everyone that we are stronger as both a city AND as a state.

A leading brand in the food industry just got bigger.

Congrats to Maryland’s own @mccormickspices on their expansion!

Today, on Trans Day of Visibility, we celebrate the strength and contributions of trans Marylanders.

As many in the trans community face growing challenges and uncertainty, Maryland remains committed to dignity, safety, and belonging for all.

We will not tolerate discrimination or harm against our trans neighbors, friends, and family members because of their identity, and as long as I am governor, Maryland will be a safe haven for our trans community.

We must be vigilant about the challenges that technologies like A.I. pose for our people, economy, and democracy. 

Yes, let’s leverage the benefits, but not at people’s expense.

Thank you to @TSA workers here in Maryland and across the country for showing up day after day, working 12+ hour shifts, and dealing with this crisis forced onto them.

We‘re grateful for their patience and positivity as they again work without pay because the federal government is failing to meet the moment.

I also want to thank everyone supporting TSA workers – including by bringing food donations – and to travelers for being patient and understanding. I know it’s frustrating, but your patien

Congrats to our newest @MarylandDNR Police officers, including both the 67th Basic Recruit Class and 66th lateral transfer class!

The NRP is the oldest statewide police force in Maryland and one of the oldest state conservation law agencies in the country. We’re incredibly proud of these officers for stepping up to protect our communities and the beauty of Maryland.

This tax season, don’t leave cash on the table. Eligible Marylanders could get up to $4,000 just by filing their state tax return through the Maryland Earned Income Tax Credit. 

Check your eligibility and find free help to file your taxes here: marylandcomptroller.gov/earn…

The Maryland Aviation Administration has been informed that ICE is deploying additional personnel to @BWI_Airport starting today.

We have been told by ICE their personnel will provide operational support and assist at @TSA security checkpoints to speed up the clearance process for passengers — not immigration enforcement. Passenger and baggage screening responsibilities will remain with trained, skilled TSA personnel.

Americans are sick and tired of Washington’s dysfunction. The federal govern

Yes, the President should address the nation.

In the face of one of the worst tragedies in our state’s history, people from all across the state stepped up to serve and help their fellow Marylanders.

At a time where too many are wondering if building big and great things is still possible in our country, Maryland will lead the way and show them that it is.

Video

Nothing more exciting than O’s-pening Day! 🐦‍⬛

This rebuild is now the fastest moving, major project in the country.

And we plan to keep it that way.

When forecasts showed job losses at the Port of Baltimore, 𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗹𝗲𝗱 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗿𝗱 𝗻𝘂𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝗼𝗳 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗶𝗻 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟱–𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮𝗱
